5 bizarre hobbies that will
make you the most intelligent
person in any room

collecting old coins

collect a few old coins and research where each one came from. every coin is a small window into an empire, a war or a long forgotten trade route across the sea.

learning bird calls

learn to recognise ten bird calls near where you live. it trains your ears and your memory, and you'll start noticing a whole world most people never hear.

a daily odd lesson

spend 5 minutes a day on one lesson in something unusual: ancient law, volcano science, the history of maps. odd knowledge makes you surprisingly interesting.

slides.texte_overlay:
solving cryptic crosswords

try one cryptic crossword every single week. the clues bend language in clever ways, and slowly cracking them teaches your mind to think around corners.

sketching buildings

sketch one building a week from life. drawing makes you really look at architecture, and you'll slowly start to see history hidden in every street you walk down.
